bug_info.bug_desc: The pre-merge rv_dm design synchronized lc_hw_debug_en_i into only one enable copy and used it solely to disable instruction fetch from the debug ROM. All other hardware-debug-enable-gated functions were left unconditionally active: DMI request/response valid/ready handshakes could pass through to the debug module CSRs, the non-debug module reset output was driven directly from the dm_csrs block, the SBA TL-UL master valid/response paths were not masked, the debug request output was sent directly to the harts, and the debug-memory adapter accepted and returned data/error responses even when the lifecycle enable was off. Consequently, when lc_hw_debug_en_i was not On, debugger-visible DMI access, ndmreset, system-bus access, hart debug requests, and debug-memory data accesses could still be asserted, violating the spec requirement that all these functions be held inactive when hardware debug enable is gated off.
bug_info.fix_hint: Synchronize lc_hw_debug_en_i into per-function enable copies and use them to gate every lifecycle-controlled path: gate the DMI request/response handshakes between dmi_jtag and dm_csrs with dmi_en, gate the ndmreset output with reset_req_en, gate the SBA host TL-UL valid signals with sba_en, gate debug_req_o with debug_req_en, and gate the debug-memory TL-UL adapter request grant, read data, read valid, and error response with rom_en while retaining en_ifetch for instruction-fetch enable control.
